name: 22947 · Keswick, VA
findings: ZIP 22947 (Keswick) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22947 (Keswick) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22947 (Keswick) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).
